say:1:1511217001:0.text: What are you doing here, Halian?
say:1:1511217001:0.source_cn: 呼临人？你来树怒山谷做什么。
say:1:1511217001:0.male: What are you doing here, Halian?
say:1:1511217001:0.female: What are you doing here, Halian?

say:2:1511217002:1.text: Wait, is that <style="highlight">Yohan</style>? Did you knock him out?
say:2:1511217002:1.male: Wait, is that <style="highlight">Yohan</style>? Did you knock him out?
say:2:1511217002:1.female: Wait, is that <style="highlight">Yohan</style>? Did you knock him out?

choice_prompt:3:1511217002.text: Wait, is that <style="highlight">Yohan</style>? Did you knock him out?
choice_prompt:3:1511217002.source_cn: 等等，那是<style=highlight>尤桑迪</style>？你把他打晕了？
choice_prompt:3:1511217002.male: Wait, is that <style="highlight">Yohan</style>? Did you knock him out?
choice_prompt:3:1511217002.female: Wait, is that <style="highlight">Yohan</style>? Did you knock him out?

say:4:1511217005:1.text: This guy is from <style="highlight">Mirehold</style>. It's a place full of <style="highlight">useless people</style> who were expelled from Wrathwood Grove.
say:4:1511217005:1.male: This guy is from <style="highlight">Mirehold</style>. It's a place full of <style="highlight">useless people</style> who were expelled from Wrathwood Grove.
say:4:1511217005:1.female: This guy is from <style="highlight">Mirehold</style>. It's a place full of <style="highlight">useless people</style> who were expelled from Wrathwood Grove.

say:5:1511217006:1.text: Take him back to Mirehold. He's no concern of ours.
say:5:1511217006:1.source_cn: 带他回水泽营地，我们不会管他。
say:5:1511217006:1.male: Take him back to Mirehold. He's no concern of ours.
say:5:1511217006:1.female: Take him back to Mirehold. He's no concern of ours.

choice_prompt:6:1511217006.text: Take him back to Mirehold. He's no concern of ours.
choice_prompt:6:1511217006.source_cn: 带他回水泽营地，我们不会管他。
choice_prompt:6:1511217006.male: Take him back to Mirehold. He's no concern of ours.
choice_prompt:6:1511217006.female: Take him back to Mirehold. He's no concern of ours.

say:7:1511217007:1.text: Mind your own business and stay out of Wildborn affairs, Halian.
say:7:1511217007:1.source_cn: 呼临人，少管雅库伯尔的事。
say:7:1511217007:1.male: Mind your own business and stay out of Wildborn affairs, Halian.
say:7:1511217007:1.female: Mind your own business and stay out of Wildborn affairs, Halian.

say:8:1511217009:1.text: You're strange, and you need to stop snooping around.
say:8:1511217009:1.source_cn: 你真奇怪，不来换东西，反而打听来打听去。
say:8:1511217009:1.male: You're strange, and you need to stop snooping around.
say:8:1511217009:1.female: You're strange, and you need to stop snooping around.

say:9:1511217010:1.text: If you don't leave right away, I'll stop being nice.
say:9:1511217010:1.male: If you don't leave right away, I'll stop being nice.
say:9:1511217010:1.female: If you don't leave right away, I'll stop being nice.

choice:6:0:1.text: Is there tension between you all?
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 你们两边分得这么清楚？
choice:6:0:1.male: Is there tension between you all?
choice:6:0:1.female: Is there tension between you all?

choice:6:2:3.text: I'm not sure what's going on...
choice:6:2:3.source_cn: 你在说什么？我完全听不懂
choice:6:2:3.male: I'm not sure what's going on...
choice:6:2:3.female: I'm not sure what's going on...

choice:3:1:2.text: I'll leave him in your care.
choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 这家伙就交给你照顾了
choice:3:1:2.male: I'll leave him in your care.
choice:3:1:2.female: I'll leave him in your care.

say:14:1511217004:1.text: Ah, so he fainted on you. Weaklings never fail to show what they are.
say:14:1511217004:1.source_cn: 哦，那他就是被你吓晕的。弱者果然就是弱者。
